# Behavioral assay API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

The lab's own implementation of a behavioral paradigm: how the task is actually run.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `behavioralassay` (detail, create, update), `behavioralassays` (list)
- **Permissions:** object permissions on the record itself (member / manager / owner roles)
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation/), [`behavioralassaymembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassaymembershipinvitation/) records; refused (400) while [`behavior`](/api/modules/behavior/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 50 characters |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `setup_type` | [`setuptype`](/api/taxonomies/setuptype/) id **[required]**; nullable |
| `behavioral_paradigm` | [`behavioralparadigm`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralparadigm/) id **[required]**. Link to the shared behavioral paradigm taxonomy |
| `licenses` | list of [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) ids; nestable. Licenses that authorize this behavioral assay |
| `is_public` | boolean. Designates if the behavioral assay is publicly available |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `groups` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('behavioralassay', load_all=True)
records = resp['behavioralassays']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('behavioralassay', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.behavioralassays;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "behavioralassays": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Behavioral assay 1",
            "description": "",
            "setup_type": "<setuptype-id>",
            "behavioral_paradigm": "<behavioralparadigm-id>",
            "licenses": [
                "<license-id>"
            ],
            "is_public": true,
            "users": null,
            "groups": null
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('behavioralassay', data={"name": "Behavioral assay 1", "setup_type": "<setuptype-id>", "behavioral_paradigm": "<behavioralparadigm-id>"})
record = resp.json()['behavioralassay']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Behavioral assay 1', 'setup_type', '<setuptype-id>', 'behavioral_paradigm', '<behavioralparadigm-id>'), 'behavioralassay');
record = created.behavioralassay;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('behavioralassay', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['behavioralassay']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('behavioralassay', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.behavioralassay;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "behavioralassay": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Behavioral assay 1",
        "description": "",
        "setup_type": "<setuptype-id>",
        "behavioral_paradigm": "<behavioralparadigm-id>",
        "licenses": [
            "<license-id>"
        ],
        "is_public": true,
        "users": null,
        "groups": null
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('behavioralassay', id='<id>', data={"name": "Behavioral assay 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Behavioral assay 1 (renamed)'), 'behavioralassay', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('behavioralassay', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'behavioralassay');
```
